description: This file defines an abstract Logger class with static instances for logging messages to standard output or error, and optionally to Android logcat. It provides methods for logging messages and exceptions, serving as a utility class within the 'com.android.commands.monkey' package.

classes.name: Logger
classes.description: Abstract class providing static logger instances for output and error streams, with functionality to log messages and exceptions, intended for use within the 'com.android.commands.monkey' package.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to output a string message.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Static method to log an exception with an accompanying message at the ERROR level.
